meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein sarees kharidna bilkul aasan hai, bas aapko sahi fabrics aur platforms ki pehchan honi chahiye. Kam budget mein heavy look dene wali sarees aur unhe kharidne ke liye best online options ki puri list niche di gayi hai:

---

### 1. Budget-Friendly Saree Fabrics (Kis tarah ki sarees kharidein?)

* **Art Silk / Banarasi Silk Blend (₹1,500 – ₹4,000):** Asli pure Banarasi ya Kanjivaram silk bohot mehnge hote hain, lekin inke **Art Silk ya Blended versions** bilkul waisa hi royal aur heavy look dete hain aur budget mein bhi aa jaate hain.
* **Organza aur Tissue Sarees (₹1,200 – ₹3,500):** Aajkal shadiyon mein lightweight organza aur tissue sarees kaafi trend mein hain. Inpe halka zari ya stonework shadi ke functions (jaise Haldi ya Mehendi) ke liye perfect lagta hai.
* **Georgette ya Chiffon with Sequins (₹1,000 – ₹3,000):** Reception ya cocktail party ke liye **sequins work** ya heavy border wali georgette sarees best option hain. Yeh pehenne mein comfortable hoti hain aur chamakdar lagti hain.

---

### 2. Best Online Websites & Apps (Kahan se kharidein?)

Aap apne budget ke hisaab se in trusted platforms ka use kar sakte hain:

* **Koskii:[www.koskii.com](https://www.koskii.com/collections/sarees#:~:text=We%20have%20the%20largest%20collection%20of%20everyday,set%20the%20stage%20for%20the%20main%20event.)** Agar aapko specifically shadi ke liye ethnic aur festive sarees chahiye (woh bhi affordable range mein), toh Koskii ki website ya app bohot accha option hai. Yahan ₹1,500 se starting range mil jaati hai.
* **Myntra & Ajio:** Agar aapko branded ya designer-look fusion sarees (jaise Sangria, Anouk, ya Indya) lenge hain, toh yahan shadi ke season mein heavy discounts aur sales milti hain jisse achhi saree saste mein mil jaati hai.
* **Mohi Fashion & Karagiri:** Yeh online stores traditional handloom, semi-silk, aur regional wedding sarees ke liye kaafi famous hain. Inke paas "Under ₹2K" aur "Under ₹5K" ka alag se budget filter hota hai.
* **Nykaa Fashion:** Yahan premium ethnic brands ka bohot acha collection milta hai, aur agar aap thoda modern ya pastel wedding look chahte hain toh yahan options mil jayenge.

---

### Smart Shopping Tips:

1.  **Sales ka fayda uthayein:** Myntra ya Ajio ki festive/end-of-season sales se shopping karne par 50% ya usse zyada ka discount mil jata hai.
2.  **Fabric details check karein:** Description mein zaroor check kar lein ki fabric "Pure Silk" ki jagah "Art Silk" ya "Silk Blend" ho, kyunki wahi budget-friendly hote hain aur look heavy dete hain.
